question: What additional attainments and foundational Kaula principle complete this enumeration of powers?
premises: The verse enumerates eight additional items.
The attainment of supernatural powers is included in this enumeration.
The root Kaula is presented as a culminating element.
inference: The eightfold set, the attainment of supernatural powers, and the root Kaula together complete the stated series of accomplishments.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight items is not specified within this verse alone.
The precise scope of mūlakaula in this context depends on the preceding verses.
plain_english: And the eight, the attainment of supernatural powers, and the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
